name: CUDA Vector Add Test
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  cuda-vectoradd-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITEA_SVC_HOST: gitea-ssh.git-local.svc.cluster.local
      GITEA_SSH_PORT: "2222"
      NAMESPACE: default
      # Optional: pin kubectl (e.g., v1.30.5). Leave empty to use latest stable.
      KUBECTL_VERSION: ""
    steps:
      - name: Install prerequisites (fast)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! command -v ssh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
            sudo apt-get update -y -q
            sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssh-client curl ca-certificates
          fi
          ssh -V
        timeout-minutes: 3

      - name: DNS & connectivity checks (in-cluster)
        shell: bash
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "=== resolv.conf ==="; cat /etc/resolv.conf || true; echo
          echo "=== getent hosts (gitea ssh svc) ==="
          getent hosts "$GITEA_SVC_HOST" || (echo "FATAL: cannot resolve $GITEA_SVC_HOST - check if running in cluster" && exit 1)
          echo
          echo "=== TCP check gitea ssh ==="
          timeout 10 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/$GITEA_SVC_HOST/$GITEA_SSH_PORT" || (echo "FATAL: cannot reach $GITEA_SVC_HOST:$GITEA_SSH_PORT" && exit 1)
          echo "✅ Connectivity check passed"

      - name: Setup SSH material
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          install -m 700 -d ~/.ssh
          umask 177
          printf '%s' "${{ secrets.CI_DEPLOY_KEY }}" > ~/.ssh/id_ci
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ci
          ssh-keyscan -p "$GITEA_SSH_PORT" "$GITEA_SVC_HOST" > ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          chmod 644 ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          {
            echo "Host $GITEA_SVC_HOST"
            echo "  HostName $GITEA_SVC_HOST"
            echo "  Port $GITEA_SSH_PORT"
            echo "  User git"
            echo "  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ci"
            echo "  IdentitiesOnly yes"
            echo "  StrictHostKeyChecking yes"
          } >> ~/.ssh/config
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/config

      - name: Clone repo (SSH via in-cluster service)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          REPO_SSH="ssh://git@${GITEA_SVC_HOST}:${GITEA_SSH_PORT}/m4xx3d0ut/platform-nvidia-compute.git"
          git clone --depth 1 --branch dev "$REPO_SSH" . || git clone --depth 1 "$REPO_SSH" .

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "${KUBECTL_VERSION}" ]; then
            URL="https://dl.k8s.io/release/${KUBECTL_VERSION}/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
          else
            URL="https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -sL https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
          fi
          curl -sSL "$URL" -o kubectl
          install -m 0755 kubectl /usr/local/bin/kubectl
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Configure kubeconfig
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p ~/.kube
          printf '%s' "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_B64 }}" | base64 -d > ~/.kube/config
          chmod 600 ~/.kube/config
          head -1 ~/.kube/config | grep -q 'apiVersion:' || { echo "Malformed kubeconfig"; exit 1; }
          kubectl --request-timeout=30s cluster-info
          kubectl --request-timeout=30s get ns

      - name: Deploy CUDA vector add test
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Validating manifest (server dry-run) ..."
          kubectl apply -f cuda-vecadd.yaml --dry-run=server -o yaml
          echo "Applying manifest ..."
          kubectl apply -f cuda-vecadd.yaml
          echo "Waiting for Job to complete ..."
          kubectl --request-timeout=30s wait -n "$NAMESPACE" --for=condition=complete job/gpu-vectoradd --timeout=600s || true

      - name: Show pod status + logs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Pods for the job:"
          if kubectl get job gpu-vectoradd -n "$NAMESPACE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # It's a Job - look for job-managed pods
            kubectl --request-timeout=30s get pods -n "$NAMESPACE" -l job-name=gpu-vectoradd -o wide
            POD="$(kubectl --request-timeout=30s get pods -n "$NAMESPACE" -l job-name=gpu-vectoradd -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}' 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
          else
            # It's a standalone Pod
            kubectl --request-timeout=30s get pod gpu-vectoradd -n "$NAMESPACE" -o wide || true
            POD="gpu-vectoradd"
          fi
          
          if [ -n "$POD" ] && [ "$POD" != "gpu-vectoradd" ] || kubectl get pod "$POD" -n "$NAMESPACE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "=== Logs from $POD ==="
            kubectl --request-timeout=30s logs -n "$NAMESPACE" "$POD" || true
          else
            echo "No pod found or pod not ready yet"
          fi
          
          echo "=== Describe resource ==="
          kubectl --request-timeout=30s describe job -n "$NAMESPACE" gpu-vectoradd 2>/dev/null || \
          kubectl --request-timeout=30s describe pod -n "$NAMESPACE" gpu-vectoradd || true

      # Check job success
      - name: Check job success
        if: success() || failure()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          
          # Check if it's a Job or Pod
          if kubectl get job gpu-vectoradd -n "$NAMESPACE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Checking Job status..."
            JOB_STATUS=$(kubectl get job gpu-vectoradd -n "$NAMESPACE" -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Complete")].status}' 2>/dev/null || echo "Unknown")
            FAILED_STATUS=$(kubectl get job gpu-vectoradd -n "$NAMESPACE" -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Failed")].status}' 2>/dev/null || echo "Unknown")
            
            if [ "$JOB_STATUS" = "True" ]; then
              echo "✅ CUDA vector add test completed successfully"
              exit 0
            elif [ "$FAILED_STATUS" = "True" ]; then
              echo "❌ CUDA vector add test failed"
              exit 1
            else
              echo "⚠️ CUDA vector add test status unclear: Complete=$JOB_STATUS, Failed=$FAILED_STATUS"
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "Checking Pod status..."
            POD_PHASE=$(kubectl get pod gpu-vectoradd -n "$NAMESPACE" -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}' 2>/dev/null || echo "Unknown")
            
            case "$POD_PHASE" in
              Succeeded)
                echo "✅ CUDA vector add test completed successfully"
                exit 0
                ;;
              Failed)
                echo "❌ CUDA vector add test failed"
                exit 1
                ;;
              *)
                echo "⚠️ CUDA vector add test in unexpected state: $POD_PHASE"
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          fi

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Cleaning up test resources..."
          kubectl delete -f cuda-vecadd.yaml --ignore-not-found=true
          echo "Cleanup complete"
